note: Yearly ministry notices only. The eleven statutory days off are computed from Bộ luật Lao động 2019 Điều 112 in lib/vn-holidays.js and must not be repeated here. What CANNOT be computed goes in this file: the extra days a given Tết is granted, the Saturdays worked in exchange, and which side of 02/09 the second National Day falls on. Add a year when its notice is published; an absent year simply falls back to the statutory rules.

defaults.why: Điều 112 grants 02/09 plus one adjacent day without fixing which side. Recent notices have used both, so the default is an assumption and every year with a published notice should state its own.

shape.extra: [{ date, id, kind: compensatory|statutory, vi, en, source }] — days off the notice adds
shape.workdays: [YYYY-MM-DD] — Saturdays worked to pay for the extra days
shape.source: the notice this year's rows came from, e.g. Thông báo .../TB-BLĐTBXH
